prompts.basalt: Create a production transparent sprite sheet for a dark fantasy illustrated pixel RTS world map. Exactly 12 isolated terrain pieces in a regular 4 columns by 3 rows grid, equal cells, generous transparent gutters, nothing touching any cell edge. No text, labels, grid lines, water background, buildings, rectangular ground plates or drop shadows. High oblique overhead orthographic view, top-left diffuse light, finely textured hand-painted 1990s RTS terrain, muted natural colours, readable silhouettes at reduced 80-110px width. Terrain bases dissolve into scattered soil/stone at their irregular edges. This is map-scale: canopy is tiny dense crowns, never individual large palm trees. Row 1: two different broad extinct crater massifs (columns1,2), two long broken radial volcanic flank ridges (columns3,4). Row 2: four low connected basalt escarpment/flank pieces of differing directions/shapes, integrating tiny tropical scrub. Row 3: two irregular dense tropical canopy groves on volcanic soil, one low rubble and fern transition, one sparse rocky coastal scrub transition. Each piece a continuous natural landform with related scale and consistent perspective. Variation A: ancient dead volcano, charcoal basalt and weathered warm grey rock, muted olive tropical vegetation in sheltered ravines, broad asymmetric dry crater, strong dark cliff faces and modest stone highlights. Absolutely no lava/fire/smoke/snow. Volcanic silhouettes are broad and eroded, not sharp alpine peaks.
